### Twenty One Capital to Host Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call on Friday, November 13th


November 5, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/307816567/files/doc_news/Twenty-One-Capital-to-Host-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Call-on-Friday-November-13th-2026.pdf)


AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Twenty One Capital, Inc. (“Twenty One” or “XXI”) (NYSE: XXI), today announced that it plans to host its first earnings conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET on Friday November 13, 2026 to discuss its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Event:**


Twenty One Capital Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call


**Date:**


Friday, November 13, 2026


**Time:**


8:30 a.m. ET


**Live Call:**


1-833-461-5787 (U.S. Toll Free) or 1-585-542-9983 (International); Meeting ID: 115 142 173


**Webcast:**


[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/115142173](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F115142173&esheet=54636361&newsitemid=20261105534093&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F115142173&index=1&md5=833dbc4d82ec8fd02bef156900639b68)


Rapha Zagury, CEO, and Steve Meehan, CFO, will host the call and address previously submitted questions.


Participants may submit a question for management consideration by emailing it toinvestors@twentyonecapital.com prior to Wednesday, November 11, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET.


For interested individuals unable to join the conference call, a dial-in replay of the call will be available until November 20, 2026, and can be accessed by dialing 1-833-309-1852 (U.S. Toll Free) and entering Meeting ID: 115 142 173.


**About Twenty One** Twenty One is a Bitcoin-focused operating company. Designed to pair one of the largest Bitcoin treasuries in the public markets with operating businesses, Twenty One aims to provide shareholders with direct, capital-efficient exposure to Bitcoin through a growing Bitcoin-native platform. For more information, visit[https://investors.xxi.money/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.xxi.money%2F&esheet=54636361&newsitemid=20261105534093&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.xxi.money%2F&index=2&md5=89e2c429185f047b71246eb01b258ba7) .
